points.title: 童年与早期教育
points.description: 契诃夫出生于俄罗斯南部港口城市塔甘罗格的一个商人家庭。他的童年生活贫困，父亲严厉而专横，家庭经济拮据。1879年，契诃夫完成中学教育，因家庭经济困难，他不得不独自前往莫斯科，与家人团聚。在塔甘罗格的岁月培养了契诃夫对底层人民的同情和对社会不公的敏感，这些主题后来成为他文学创作的重要元素。
points.descriptionEn: Chekhov was born in Taganrog, a port city in southern Russia, to the family of a grocer. His childhood was marked by poverty; his father was authoritarian and the family struggled financially. In 1879, Chekhov completed his secondary education and, due to financial difficulties, he had to travel alone to Moscow to reunite with his family. The years in Taganrog shaped Chekhov's sympathy for the common people and his sensitivity to social injustice, themes that would become central to his literary work.

points.title: 医学教育与早期创作
points.description: 契诃夫进入莫斯科大学医学院学习，同时开始为幽默杂志撰稿，以补贴家用。他的早期作品多为幽默短篇，署名'安·契洪特'。1884年，契诃夫获得医学学位，但文学创作已占据他生活的重要部分。这一时期，他创作了大量幽默短篇小说，如《变色龙》《苦恼》等，展现了对社会现象的敏锐观察和独特的讽刺风格。医学背景使他的作品具有独特的客观性和对人物心理的深刻洞察。
points.descriptionEn: Chekhov entered the Medical Faculty of Moscow University while simultaneously contributing humorous stories to magazines to supplement his family's income. His early works were mostly humorous short stories published under the pseudonym 'Antosha Chekhonte.' In 1884, Chekhov obtained his medical degree, but literature had already become an important part of his life. During this period, he wrote numerous humorous short stories such as 'Chameleon' and 'Misery,' demonstrating his keen observation of social phenomena and unique satirical style. His medical background gave his works a distinctive objectivity and profound insight into human psychology.

points.title: 创作转型期
points.description: 1887年，契诃夫的短篇小说《草原》发表，标志着他从幽默讽刺向严肃文学创作的转变。他的作品逐渐获得文学界认可，1888年获得普希金文学奖。这一时期，契诃夫创作了《伊凡诺夫》《林妖》等戏剧作品，开始探索更复杂的主题。他放弃了早期作品的夸张手法，转向更内敛、更真实的表达方式。契诃夫的文学风格日益成熟，形成了独特的'契诃夫式'风格——简洁、含蓄而富有深意。
points.descriptionEn: In 1887, Chekhov's short story 'The Steppe' was published, marking his transition from humorous satire to more serious literary creation. His works gradually gained recognition in literary circles, and in 1888 he received the Pushkin Prize. During this period, Chekhov wrote plays such as 'Ivanov' and 'The Wood Demon,' beginning to explore more complex themes. He abandoned the exaggerated techniques of his early works in favor of a more restrained and authentic expression. Chekhov's literary style matured, forming his distinctive 'Chekhovian' style—concise, subtle, and profound.

points.title: 萨哈林岛考察
points.description: 1890年，契诃夫前往萨哈林岛(库页岛)进行为期三个月的考察，研究流放犯人的生活状况。这次考察对他产生了深远影响，使他亲眼目睹了沙皇制度的残酷和不公。1893-1894年，他发表了《萨哈林岛游记》，详细记录了所见所闻，揭露了流放制度的黑暗面。这次经历深化了契诃夫的社会责任感，也丰富了他的创作素材。回到莫斯科后，他创作了《第六病室》《带阁楼的房子》等作品，对社会问题进行了更深入的探讨。
points.descriptionEn: In 1890, Chekhov traveled to Sakhalin Island for a three-month expedition to study the living conditions of exiles. This journey had a profound impact on him, allowing him to witness firsthand the cruelty and injustice of the Tsarist system. Between 1893-1894, he published 'The Island of Sakhalin,' a detailed account of his observations that exposed the dark side of the exile system. This experience deepened Chekhov's sense of social responsibility and enriched his creative materials. After returning to Moscow, he wrote works such as 'Ward No. 6' and 'The House with an Attic,' exploring social issues in greater depth.

points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 1899年，契诃夫因健康恶化移居克里米亚的雅尔塔，在那里度过了生命的最后五年。尽管健康状况不佳，他进入了创作巅峰期，完成了《海鸥》《万尼亚舅舅》《三姐妹》《樱桃园》等经典剧作。这些作品以简洁的对话和含蓄的表达，深刻探讨了现代人的精神困境和生活的意义。1904年，契诃夫在德国巴登魏勒去世，年仅44岁。他的作品对20世纪戏剧和文学产生了深远影响，被誉为现代戏剧的奠基人之一。契诃夫的'潜台词'理论和'日常生活的诗意'探索，影响了无数后来的作家和戏剧家。
points.descriptionEn: In 1899, due to deteriorating health, Chekhov moved to Yalta in Crimea, where he spent the last five years of his life. Despite his poor health, he entered a period of creative peak, completing masterpieces such as 'The Seagull,' 'Uncle Vanya,' 'Three Sisters,' and 'The Cherry Orchard.' These works, with their concise dialogue and subtle expression, profoundly explored the spiritual dilemmas of modern people and the meaning of life. In 1904, Chekhov died in Badenweiler, Germany, at the age of 44. His works had a profound impact on 20th-century theater and literature, and he is regarded as one of the founders of modern drama. Chekhov's theories of 'subtext' and the exploration of 'poetry in everyday life' have influenced countless later writers and dramatists.

appraisal.zh: 契诃夫被公认为现代短篇小说与戏剧的奠基人之一，以简洁含蓄的笔法开创“潜台词”，在日常细节中揭示人性的复杂，并寄托对社会不公的关切与对人类尊严的捍卫。也有研究者指出其作品结构松散、情节推进缓慢，戏剧缺少强烈冲突与明确结局，对社会问题只提问而不给出路，政治上亦被指缺乏明确的革命意识。总体而言，他已成为现实主义与现代主义交汇的经典符号，与易卜生、斯特林堡并称现代戏剧奠基人，其影响延及电影与电视。
appraisal.en: Chekhov is widely regarded as a founder of the modern short story and drama, pioneering 'subtext' through concise, restrained writing that reveals human complexity in ordinary detail while voicing concern for social injustice and human dignity. Yet some researchers note loose structure and slow plots, dramas lacking strong conflict or clear resolution, and a habit of raising social questions without answers; politically he is faulted for lacking clear revolutionary consciousness. On balance he stands as a classic symbol where realism meets modernism, ranked with Ibsen and Strindberg as a founder of modern drama, his influence reaching film and television.

supporter.zh: 契诃夫被赞誉为现代短篇小说和戏剧的奠基人，他的作品以其独特的艺术风格和深刻的人性洞察力而闻名。支持者认为，契诃夫通过简洁而含蓄的表达方式，揭示了人类内心世界的复杂性，开创了'潜台词'的艺术手法。他的作品不仅具有极高的文学价值，还体现了对社会不公的关切和对人类尊严的捍卫。契诃夫的艺术遗产在于他证明了日常生活中的平凡细节也能蕴含深刻的人性探索，这种影响延续至今。
supporter.en: Chekhov is celebrated as a founder of the modern short story and drama, renowned for his unique artistic style and profound insight into human nature. Supporters argue that through concise and subtle expression, Chekhov revealed the complexity of the inner world and pioneered the artistic technique of 'subtext.' His works possess not only high literary value but also reflect concern for social injustice and defense of human dignity. Chekhov's artistic legacy lies in demonstrating that ordinary details in daily life can contain profound explorations of human nature, an influence that endures to this day.

critic.zh: 批评者指出契诃夫的作品存在结构松散、情节发展缓慢的问题，认为他的戏剧缺乏强烈的戏剧冲突和明确的结局。一些评论家认为契诃夫过于悲观，作品中弥漫着对生活的无力感和虚无主义倾向。此外，有批评者认为契诃夫对社会问题的解决方案过于模糊，只提出问题而不提供明确的出路。在政治立场上，他被指责为缺乏明确的革命意识，未能积极参与推动社会变革，仅停留在对现状的批判层面。
critic.en: Critics point out that Chekhov's works suffer from loose structure and slow plot development, arguing that his dramas lack strong dramatic conflict and clear resolutions. Some commentators believe Chekhov was overly pessimistic, with his works permeated by a sense of powerlessness and nihilism toward life. Furthermore, critics argue that Chekhov's solutions to social problems are too vague, raising questions without providing clear answers. Politically, he has been accused of lacking clear revolutionary consciousness and failing to actively participate in promoting social change, remaining only at the level of criticizing the status quo.

objective.zh: 从历史与流行文化视角看，契诃夫已成为世界文学的经典符号，代表着现实主义与现代主义的交汇点。他的作品被翻译成多种语言，在全球范围内广泛演出和研究。契诃夫的'契诃夫式风格'已成为文学术语，描述那种含蓄、内敛而富有深意的表达方式。在戏剧史上，他与易卜生、斯特林堡并称为现代戏剧的三大奠基人。契诃夫的影响超越了文学领域，延伸到电影、电视等现代艺术形式，他的'潜台词'理论成为导演和演员的重要参考。契诃夫的形象也已成为知识分子的象征，代表着对人性复杂性的深刻理解和对艺术纯粹性的坚持。
objective.en: From a historical and popular culture perspective, Chekhov has become a classic symbol in world literature, representing the intersection of realism and modernism. His works have been translated into numerous languages and are widely performed and studied globally. The 'Chekhovian style' has become a literary term describing a subtle, restrained, and profound expression. In theater history, he is regarded alongside Ibsen and Strindberg as one of the three founders of modern drama. Chekhov's influence extends beyond literature into modern art forms such as film and television, with his theory of 'subtext' serving as an important reference for directors and actors. Chekhov's image has also become a symbol of the intellectual, representing a deep understanding of human complexity and a commitment to artistic purity.

self.zh: 不要直接告诉我月亮在发光，让我看到玻璃上的反光。
self.en: Don't tell me the moon is shining; show me the glint of light on broken glass.
